messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Hanta virus Kuma 🙄 saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta Kuma aji tsoran Allah a dinga fadar gaskiya da Kuma yada alkairi

output.original_text: Hanta virus Kuma 🙄 saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta Kuma aji tsoran Allah a dinga fadar gaskiya da Kuma yada alkairi
output.joy: Hanta virus Kuma! 🙄 A yanzu, akwai sababbin ci gaba game da cuta, Amma da fatan za mu dinga fadar gaskiya da yada alkairi!
output.sadness: Hanta virus Kuma... 😔 Zuwa yanzu, zuciya virus har ya fara haifar da wata cuta, Abu ne mai damuwa, amma zamu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi.
output.fear: Hanta virus Kuma 😨 Al'amuran sun yi tsanani da zuciya virus, har an fara kirkirar wata cuta, Allah ya sa mu dinga fadar gaskiya da yada alkairi.
output.anger: Hanta virus Kuma 😡 Ya kamata mu yi magana akan zuciya virus har ya zama anan, yayin da suke kirkirar wata cuta, ya kamata mu dinga fadar gaskiya da yada alkairi!
output.surprise: Hanta virus Kuma! 😲 Ina jin labarin zuciya virus ya fara zama wani sabon talakawa, Ya kamata mu dinga fadar gaskiya da yada alkairi!
output.disgust: Hanta virus Kuma 😒 Wannan zuciya virus yana da matukar ƙazanta, har sun fara kirkirar wata cuta, ya kamata a rika fadar gaskiya da yada alkairi!
